Accenture Federal Services, a wholly owned subsidiary of Accenture
, announced on Thursday that it won a $480.37M firm-fixed-price contract to deliver the Joint Enterprise Task Management System.
The system will replace legacy task and correspondence management systems across the Department of War, with work to be performed in Fort Belvoir, Virginia.
The contract has an estimated completion date of February 15, 2032, extending the project over more than five years.
Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds from the army will be obligated at a later time.
Army Contracting Command is the contracting activity.

title: Accenture's unit wins $480M U.S. Army deal for task management system
